title: Existing education job watch with bounded DOE source evidence

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Recovered native policy confirms the connected DOE worker plus continuing original district/charter searches; actual bridge and source access still need verification.
Search current official employers across all Delaware districts and charter schools; DOE-only packet never establishes full requested coverage.
Keep candidate qualifications and fit preferences in the private policy; preserve all inclusion, certification-pathway and exclusion criteria without inferring new credentials.
Before detailed analysis, compare stable vacancy ID, official URL, posted/modified date and relevant fields with verified task-specific reported history.
Skip unchanged listings only when prior detailed review/report is verified; source unchanged alone never means the candidate was reviewed or reported.
Reassess new or materially changed listings and reuse verified pages within the run; missing history is a hold, never an empty prior history.
First complete DOE source read seeds its source state; partial reads preserve fingerprints and unknown counts, never inferred vacancy closure.
Use bounded cleanup and immutable source/readback; unknown cleanup or missing atomic artifact blocks refetch.
Notify only meaningful new matches; no meaningful matches stays quiet only when required source and report-history coverage are complete.

success_checks: Each strong new match includes employer/title, student population/contact, full-time/remote status, salary/scale, pension confidence, deadline, certification/pathway, qualifications, physical/on-site requirements and direct application link.
Fit is grounded in verified private criteria and listing evidence; uncertain salary, pension or qualification facts remain explicit.
Coverage distinguishes DOE and district/charter sources, with observation dates and prior-report comparisons; no false no-jobs claim from failed or partial sources.
Only meaningful new or materially changed matches enter the existing destination; output readback and task-specific reported history remain distinct from retrieval.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
